name: Forgotten Lectures - Fall of a Dynasty
source:
Humanity went out to the stars and conquered a significant portion of the known galaxy. While technology advanced society did not necessarily. Greed, the struggle for power and influence is stronger than ever before and while besieged from outside forces there’s not lack of internal strife.

[From [url=https://forgotten-lectures.itch.io/forgotten-lectures-fall-of-a-dynasty]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
人类走向星际并征服了已知星系的很大一部分。虽然技术先进社会却不一定。贪婪、权力和影响力的斗争比以往任何时候都更加激烈，在外力围攻的同时也不乏内讧。

[来自[url=https://forgotten-lectures.itch.io/forgotten-lectures-fall-of-a-dynasty]Itch.io[/url]]
